title: Cavity Barriers – Siderise
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Elevation N, L05 slab edge

questions.q: Barrier labelled Siderise, horizontal (RH) or vertical (RV) type matching its position, undamaged?

guideRS.title: Riding School – cavity barriers
guideRS.src: WEA Riding School spec SJWS-WEA-RS-XX-SP-A (C00, 16-03-2026) P12

questions.q: In position, tight to both faces of the cavity, no gaps at joints?
Brackets impaled at the Siderise centres for this barrier, end brackets within 300 mm of each end?
questions.source: Siderise installation guide; Field issue (brackets >300 mm from end)

questions.q: Joints butted and taped, no gaps at junctions, corners or around brackets and services?
Fixings steel (no plastic plugs or clips)?
Matches the benchmark for this barrier type?
Ask the fitter: What's the max distance from the end of a length to the first bracket? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Barrier labelled, with photos taken before it is covered?
questions.source: CLM cavity barrier ITP CLM-00002 8.1 – OneTrace record

questions.q: Barrier not damaged or displaced by following trades (cladding, services)?

notOk.t: Siderise brackets more than 300 mm from the end of a length
Barrier not tight to both faces / not flush with the slab
Foil facing torn or barrier damaged before cover-up
Barrier dirty or damaged when the next trade covers it

ask.q: What bracket centres does this Siderise barrier need?
ask.a: As the Siderise data for this barrier; end brackets within 300 mm of each end.

ask.q: How do the joints and ends get sealed?
ask.a: Butted tight and taped/foil-sealed to the Siderise detail – no gaps.

ask.q: What's the max spacing between barriers in this cavity?
ask.a: Not more than 20 m in any direction (or as the fire strategy).
